topic: The TV remote hiding in the sofa cushions.

episode.title: If Things Could Talk: The Missing TV Remote

shots.narration: I wanted a break, not a sofa search party.
shots.scene: Cosy modern living room, colourful sofa, vertical 9:16 composition, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text, remote buttons with blank coloured shapes.
shots.action: A charcoal TV remote with big cartoon eyes and a small mischievous mouth slides between two sofa cushions.

shots.narration: Finally, somewhere nobody can press my buttons.
shots.scene: Snug gap between soft teal sofa cushions, vertical 9:16 composition, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text.
shots.action: The charcoal remote with big cartoon eyes and a small contented mouth reclines against the cushion fabric.

shots.narration: [surprised] Okay, this break has become a burial.
shots.scene: Inside the teal sofa cushion gap, vertical 9:16 composition, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text.
shots.action: A loose cushion drops over the charcoal remote with big startled cartoon eyes and a small round mouth.

shots.narration: Apparently, the sofa has a basement.
shots.scene: Deep fabric-lined sofa crevice beneath the cushions, vertical 9:16 composition, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text.
shots.action: The charcoal remote with big worried cartoon eyes and a small tense mouth slides down the steep fabric crevice.
shots.mood: Dim blue fabric shadows, exaggerated suspense.

shots.narration: The neighbours are crumbs. They seem very settled.
shots.scene: Bottom of the sofa crevice, scattered crumbs and a plain coin, vertical 9:16 composition, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text.
shots.action: The charcoal remote with big uneasy cartoon eyes and a small disgusted mouth nudges a crumb away.

shots.narration: [sighs] Yes, search the same empty cushion again.
shots.scene: Cutaway view of adjacent sofa cushion gaps, remote visible in the deeper gap, vertical 9:16 composition, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text.
shots.action: A human hand rummages through the empty gap beside the charcoal remote with big exasperated cartoon eyes and a small frown.
shots.mood: Bright light above, comic frustration below.

shots.narration: Daylight! I've never appreciated questionable upholstery this much.
shots.scene: Open sofa crevice beneath a teal cushion, vertical 9:16 composition, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text.
shots.action: A human hand lifts the cushion above the charcoal remote with big hopeful cartoon eyes and a small delighted mouth.
shots.mood: A broad shaft of warm light, triumphant relief.

shots.narration: Rescued, dusted, and immediately back on duty.
shots.scene: Beside the open sofa cushion gap, vertical 9:16 composition, bright 3D cartoon style, remote buttons with blank coloured shapes, no visible text.
shots.action: A human hand lifts the charcoal remote with big relieved cartoon eyes and a small weary smile from the crevice.

shots.narration: [whispers] That sock downstairs owes me an explanation. And rent.
shots.scene: Sofa arm above an exposed strip of floor, one dusty sock beneath the sofa, vertical 9:16 composition, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text.
shots.action: The charcoal remote with big suspicious cartoon eyes and a small sly mouth leans over the sofa arm toward the sock below.
shots.mood: Warm living-room light, conspiratorial comic reveal.

episode.endHook: Next episode: the lonely sock under the sofa explains everything.
episode.description: A TV remote sneaks between the sofa cushions for a well-earned break. Unfortunately, getting lost is much easier than getting found.
